name: Single-piece geometric control
content: Determine the geometrically controlled squares of ONLY the selected piece in the authoritative current Classic chess position. Use its actual type, color, location and board occupancy. Pawn controls are forward diagonals (White towards higher ranks, Black towards lower ranks), not forward movement squares. Knights jump by (1,2)/(2,1). Kings control adjacent squares regardless of king safety; castling is not control. Bishops, rooks and queens follow their permitted rays up to and INCLUDING the first occupied square, then stop. Include squares occupied by friendly pieces. Pins, checks and king safety do not remove geometric controls. Exclude the selected piece's own square and squares outside a1..h8. Do not evaluate positions, propose moves or calculate continuations. After any configured reasoning, return only one JSON object: {"controls":["d5","d7"]}. The example is illustrative, not a suggested answer. List all controlled squares exactly once, sorted lexicographically, using lowercase algebraic coordinates. If none, return {"controls":[]}.
